title: Add the Item record and the save use case
summary: Add the Item record for UC-01. A save returns an id. The state moves from draft to active to archived. This packet does not add a second entity.

lane.reason: The change is pure domain data and needs no local hardware.

definitions.definition: record Item { id: string, state: draft | active | archived }

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Adds the Item record. No prior public contract exists.

regression_tests.name: item_id_present_after_save
regression_tests.asserts: A saved item has an id.

regression_tests.name: item_draft_to_active
regression_tests.asserts: An item moves from draft to active and does not skip.

regression_tests.name: item_active_to_archived
regression_tests.asserts: An active item moves to archived and does not skip.

contract_notes: UC-01 constraint: a saved item has an id. Test: item_id_present_after_save.
Item transitions are draft to active, then active to archived. Do not skip a state.
